title: Kooky Gooey Norwegian Pepper Pasta
description: A vegan Norwegian dish featuring mixed peppers and a pasta water emulsion, served on a talavera plate. This cultured and gooey pasta is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the mixed peppers and garlic until tender.
In a blender or food processor, combine the cooked pasta, sauteed peppers and garlic, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, pasta water, salt, and black pepper.
Blend the mixture on high speed until it is smooth and creamy.
Return the mixture to the skillet and stir over low heat until the sauce is heated through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the pasta on a talavera plate and garnish with additional mixed peppers if desired.
Let the pasta cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the sauce to thicken.
